styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep navy-to-royal-blue gradient studio #0E2A5C to #1D5CB8 for hero and infographic screens, light ice-blue #C9DEF2 for comparison panel, bright bathroom tile for the spec card
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool soft studio key light with a controlled white glow rim and soft contact shadows, golden bounce only from the yellow podium accents
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte gradient backdrop, satin golden-yellow cylindrical podium #FFC845, light cream textured macro surface #EFE9E0, frosted translucent glass card #EDF3FA
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines, bold white on blue panels and deep navy #10254D on light panels, all copy wrapped in 「」, headlines 28-48pt and labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line white icons inside thin gold-ring circular badges #FFC845 outline
styleLock.presentationRules: product always upright or on a clean diagonal with the handle as visual axis, stable scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cool-blue electric toothbrush ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of royal blue #1D5CB8 and deep navy #0E2A5C backgrounds, ice blue #C9DEF2 light panels, pure white #FFFFFF product and text, deep navy text #10254D, and one golden-yellow accent #FFC845; cool soft studio key light with a controlled white glow rim and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent thin-line white icons inside thin gold-ring circular badges; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright or diagonal product posture with the handle as the visual axis; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
